scoring_justification: Recomputing from full DFT outputs is infeasible in the checker sandbox; compare extracted values to paper-reported DFT results with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for critical width, tensile/compressive stress thresholds, and terrace-width ratio
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported DFT results: critical width ~13 carbon rows (step 4), tensile_max ~-10 kbar and compressive_max ~+10 kbar (step 5), terrace ratio ~1.5 (step 9).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reasoning chain and results text; no fabrication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own computed numbers; tolerances allow minor variations due to code/pseudopotential choice while preserving the reproduction target.

schema.required: A single integer or float, without additional characters or whitespace, representing the number of carbon rows.

outputs.description: The critical graphene-ribbon width (carbon rows) for the flat-to-corrugated transition, read as a plain number.
Maximum tensile and compressive excess stress (in kbar) in the optimized graphene overlayer, from the ribbon and infinite-layer simulations.

schema.required: A single float, without additional characters or whitespace, representing the ratio of staircase terrace width to moiré period.

outputs.description: The dimensionless ratio of the optimal stepped‑terrace width (9.5 a_Ni) to the moiré beating period on flat Ni(100), derived from the stepped‑surface DFT simulation.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are extracted from DFT simulations. The hidden checker compares the agent’s numbers to the paper’s reported DFT values with appropriate per‑artifact tolerances; no gold values are disclosed here. Structural sanity checks are also performed (tensile_max negative, compressive_max positive, ratio > 1.0).
